items.title: Presentation: Understanding Progressive Collapse: How To Avoid A Cascading Failure
items.blurb: Sam Newman discusses the concept of progressive collapse in civil engineering and how it applies to distributed systems.

items.title: Modern Enterprise Architecture: Architecting for Outcomes • Simon Rohrer
BGP Role model: tracking the adoption of RFC 9234
items.blurb: RFC 9234 lets routers reject route leaks on their own, using BGP Roles and the Only to Customer attribute. We measured who has deployed it, and found two Tier 1 networks unexpectedly stripping OTC.

items.title: React Router v8: A Deliberately Boring Release with ESM-Only Builds and Default Middleware
items.blurb: React Router v8 was released on June 17, 2026, with minimal breaking changes and new baselines. Key updates include an ESM-only build and default middleware settings. React Router v6 and Remix v2 have reached End of Life.

items.title: Presentation: From Fab To Token - The State Of The Market
items.blurb: Jordan Nanos discusses how semiconductor constraints, data center expansion, and networking bottlenecks impact AI software architecture.
